 What's On ‘It’s pure magic’: Block Rockin’ Beats to return to Limerick city this summer
 By Ellie McCarthy 
 Published 16th Nov 2026, 10:19 GMT Dolans Combining the biggest anthems of the 90s and beyond with powerful live instrumentation, production and an electric atmosphere, the show has become a standout attraction at venues and festivals nationwide
 Dec Pierce’s Block Rockin’ Beats is making a return to Limerick ’s King John’s Castle this May bank holiday weekend. 
 Known to be one of Ireland’s most exciting live shows, Block Rockin’ Beats has become a firm favourite with audiences across the country, delivering a celebration of the world’s biggest dance anthems, performed by a full live band and special guest vocalists.

Set against the stunning backdrop of King John’s Castle, the show promises an unforgettable night of music, energy and nostalgia, bringing together some of the most iconic tracks from The Prodigy, Faithless, Underworld, The Chemical Brothers and many more. 
 Created by Today FM presenter Dec Pierce, Block Rockin’ Beats has grown from a hugely popular radio show into one of Ireland’s most successful live dance music experiences.

 The event will take place on May 2, 2027. 
 Combining the biggest anthems of the 90s and beyond with powerful live instrumentation, production and an electric atmosphere, the show has become a standout attraction at venues and festivals nationwide. 
 Following a series of hugely successful headline performances, Dec Pierce and his band will bring their trademark high-energy show back to Limerick for what promises to be one of the highlights of the May bank holiday weekend. 
 Speaking about the show, Dec Pierce said: “The show is all about energy, nostalgia, fun—we want you to completely lose yourself for a few hours. It’s more than a gig; it’s a trip back through the anthems that shaped us, powered by a full live band and incredible guest vocalists. When the crowd meets the band at full tilt, it’s pure magic.”
 Commenting ahead of the announcement, Mick Dolan said: “Block Rockin’ Beats has always been a fantastic show for Limerick audiences. Dec and the band create an incredible atmosphere, and bringing that energy back to King John’s Castle on the May bank holiday weekend is something we’re really looking forward to. It’s going to be a brilliant night.” 
 With its unique combination of dance classics, live music and spectacular production, Dec Pierce’s Block Rockin’ Beats at King John’s Castle on Sunday, May 2, 2027, promises to be an unforgettable night in the heart of Limerick city. 
 Tickets go on sale this Friday, November 20, at 10am, and are priced at €59.50, including a booking fee.
 They can be purchased from www.dolans.ie and www.ticketmaster.ie . 
 Gates open at 7pm on the night and it is over 18s only.
